title: The Spectral Geometry of Ternary Gamma Schemes:Sheaf-Theoretic Foundations and Laplacian Clustering
summary: This article develops a self-contained affine $Γ$-scheme theory for a class of commutative ternary $Γ$-semirings. By establishing all geometric and spectral results internally, the work provides a unified framework for triadic symmetry and spectral analysis. The central thesis is that a triadic $Γ$-algebra canonically induces two primary structures: (i) an intrinsic triadic symmetry in the sense of a Nambu--Filippov-type fundamental identity on the structure sheaf, and (ii) a canonical Laplacian on the finite $Γ$-spectrum whose spectral decomposition detects the clopen (connected-component)…
